descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: It's our first evening in the new house and we still haven't agreed who gets the top shelf. You've already hung a painting up there. It's upside down. I haven't said anything yet, because you looked so pleased with it. The workshop smells of sawdust, and one of the hanging plants already has a name. You called it Gerald.
descriptor.title: A House for Two

open-the-house.hint_a: There's more than one way through the workshop.
open-the-house.hint_b: Go to the bell in the loft.
open-the-house.title: Open the House

the-room-below.hint_a: Look for a way down and retrieve the ball.
the-room-below.title: The Room Below

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.completion_text: Both lights are able to reach the garden.
descriptor.summary: Somebody was meant to water the ferns this week, and I'm sure it was you. You're just as sure it was me. It's warm under the glass, and the hanging baskets drip on whoever stands underneath, which today was me. My hat is soaked. Let's water them together and never talk about it again.
descriptor.title: Conservatory

a-light-above.hint_a: Point the light at the top steps.
a-light-above.title: A Light Above

the-way-light-returns.hint_a: Leave the lower crossing lit and wait in the garden.
the-way-light-returns.hint_b: Open the return shutter and bring both lights to the garden.
the-way-light-returns.title: The Way Light Returns

descriptor.checkpoint_text:
The lift has a memory of the way up. Your pips remain in the same place.

Next: switch roles, drop the seed down, then open the garden.
descriptor.completion_text: The loft is open and the garden is growing. Your two saved stages can be played as a single memory.
descriptor.summary: The little cottage up top has been empty all winter, and today we're moving in. Right after breakfast, you said. We're on our second pot of tea on the doorstep now, and you've just asked if there's any more toast. There isn't. The cottage looks a bit lonely up there on its own. Finish your cup and I'll wash up, then we're going.
descriptor.title: First Steps

a-little-lift.hint_a: Stand on the power pad. Keep it glowing, then finish your recording.
a-little-lift.hint_b: Step onto the low lift. Ride up, walk to the bell and ring it.

a-place-to-grow.hint_a: Take the seed upstairs. Throw from the marked edge, then open the garden with the other pad.
a-place-to-grow.hint_b: Catch the seed at the lower ring. Bring it to the garden and plant when the leaves open.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: I'm writing this from the deck, where the breeze is lovely and nobody's shouting. Well, you're shouting. You say the grass down below is warmer, and you've said it about nine times since lunch. I can see your hat from up here and it looks very small. Come up and see for yourself, or I'll come down, but only for a bit.
descriptor.title: High and Low

down-and-around.hint_a: Open a way through the lower islands.

upper-path.hint_a: Help your partner reach the loft.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: You went out this morning and you still aren't back. I've been standing at the door since the fireflies came out. Just getting some air, in case you ask. The kettle's been boiled twice and gone cold twice. Come home whichever way you like, just don't take all night.
descriptor.title: Long Way Home

a-place-beside-you.hint_a: Pick a window to greet your friend when they come home.
a-place-beside-you.hint_b: Follow the open path and light the second window.
a-place-beside-you.title: A Place Beside You

the-path-you-leave.hint_a: Leave a trail for your friend and then go to the garden on your own.
the-path-you-leave.title: The Path You Leave

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: You went out this morning and you still aren't back. I've been standing at the door since the fireflies came out. Just getting some air, in case you ask. The kettle's been boiled twice and gone cold twice. Come home whichever way you like, just don't take all night.
descriptor.title: Long Way Home

a-place-beside-you.hint_a: Wait at the porch window or light the hall lamp and wait at the garden window.
a-place-beside-you.hint_b: Follow the trail they left behind. Match the gate to the lamp and light the second window.
a-place-beside-you.title: A Place Beside You

the-path-you-leave.hint_a: Leave a trail for your friend and then go to the garden on your own.
the-path-you-leave.title: The Path You Leave

descriptor.checkpoint_text:
The relay will remember your seed and the first bridge will remain open. You may leave here and come back later.

Next: swap pips and bring the light to the far island.
descriptor.completion_text: Three islands are awake. You can now play your two saved stages together as one memory.
descriptor.summary: Three islands in a row and one bench, and you got to it first again. You said you were saving it for me, and then you lay down on all of it. The cottage at the far end looks lovely from here. I suppose I'll go and check. If I'm not back by supper, come and find me, and bring the biscuits.
descriptor.title: The Relay Isles

garden.hint_a: Take the seed from the relay. Hold the next plate and throw.
garden.hint_b: Follow both bridges, catch the seed and plant it.

relay.hint_a: Hold the west plate and throw to the middle island.
relay.hint_b: Catch the seed, then place it in the relay socket.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: It's a short walk home across the meadow, or it should be. You've stopped to say hello to every bee, and some of them twice. We set off after lunch and I can still see the tree we sat under. I've started counting bees too, so I can't really tell you off. See you at the next hedge.
descriptor.title: Rolling Home

bring-it-home.hint_a: Bring the ball back for your partner.

weight-of-a-friend.hint_a: Help your partner cross with the ball's weight.
weight-of-a-friend.hint_b: Find what keeps both crossings open.

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: The striped lighthouse over the water has been dark all year. I'm fairly sure it's haunted. You packed a picnic anyway, with the good jam. If a ghost turns up, I'm telling it the sandwiches were your idea. Save me the one with the most jam.
descriptor.title: Sleeping Lighthouse

a-welcome-left-on.hint_a: The lens has reached the tower. Turn the upper mirror, then hold its light pad. Leave that half of the welcome shining.
a-welcome-left-on.hint_b: Meet your friend's light at the tower. Align the lower mirror, then stand on the crest and leave the light on together.
a-welcome-left-on.title: A Welcome, Left On

after-the-first-bell.hint_a: Light the first path long enough for your partner to reach Rest Rock, then light the second. Record both parts before finishing.
after-the-first-bell.hint_b: Follow the first light to Rest Rock, then the second to the tower bell. A path keeps your footsteps once you enter it.
after-the-first-bell.title: After the First Bell

borrowed-light.hint_a: Stand on the light pad. Keep it shining, then finish your recording.
borrowed-light.hint_b: Turn the mirror toward the receiver. Cross the lit bridge and ring the Court bell.
borrowed-light.title: Borrowed Light

missing-piece.hint_a: Turn the Court mirror toward North. Leave the path lit for your partner.
missing-piece.hint_b: Follow the lit bridge. Take the lens, then fit it into the matching Court cradle.
missing-piece.title: The Missing Piece

two-promises.hint_a: The fitted lens has two paths. Turn the upper mirror toward North and leave that promise lit.
two-promises.hint_b: Your friend's North light is kept. Cross the safe South bridge and align the other mirror so both symbols shine.
two-promises.title: Two Promises

what-carried-you.hint_a: The paths remember. Take the Court lens and leave it on the matching perch at Rest Rock for your partner.
what-carried-you.hint_b: Meet your friend's recording at Rest Rock. Take the lens they leave, then fit it into the tower projector.
what-carried-you.title: What Carried You Can Come With You

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.completion_text: You're both out of the well.
descriptor.summary: We each tossed a coin in the well, and you keep asking what I wished for. I'm not telling. You guessed six times on the way back and got it wrong six times, though one was close. Up the cliff, the windows are coming on one by one. It's getting chilly, so bring a jumper if you come back out.
descriptor.title: The Wishing Well

back-for-you.hint_a: They're still holding on. Bring the ladder down.
back-for-you.hint_b: Get out of the well and sound the bell.
back-for-you.title: Back for You

go-on-ahead.hint_a: Hop down and hold the rope.
go-on-ahead.title: Go On Ahead

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: The boats came in hours ago and we're still down on the sand, counting crabs in the rock pools. I make it eleven. You make it nine, and you say I counted the same crab twice. That one was a different crab, it was waving. The sky's going pink and my feet are cold, but I want a recount.
descriptor.title: Turn of the Tide

set-the-tide.hint_a: Turn the tide for your friend and wait on a step by the wheel.
set-the-tide.hint_b: Cross when the tide is right and ring the harbour bell.
set-the-tide.title: Set the Tide

slack-water.hint_a: Pull what you can reach while the sea is shut. Then open it, pull the rest and turn the sea wheel to your post's level.
slack-water.hint_b: A crossing stays open once you step on it. Fetch the pin, key or line at the mill, then light the lantern.
slack-water.title: Slack Water

descriptor.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
descriptor.summary: The boats came in hours ago and we're still down on the sand, counting crabs in the rock pools. I make it eleven. You make it nine, and you say I counted the same crab twice. That one was a different crab, it was waving. The sky's going pink and my feet are cold, but I want a recount.
descriptor.title: Turn of the Tide

set-the-tide.hint_a: Turn the tide for your friend and wait on a step by the wheel.
set-the-tide.hint_b: Cross when the tide is right and ring the harbour bell.
set-the-tide.title: Set the Tide

slack-water.hint_a: Pull what you can reach while the sea is shut. Then open it, pull the rest and turn the sea wheel to your post's level.
slack-water.hint_b: Let your friend cross before you turn the tide. Then fetch the pin, key or line at the mill and light the lantern.
slack-water.title: Slack Water

Up the cliff, the windows are coming on one by one. It's getting chilly, so bring a jumper if you come back out.
chapters.title: The Wishing Well

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.summary: You went out this morning and you still aren't back. I've been standing at the door since the fireflies came out. Just getting some air, in case you ask. The kettle's been boiled twice and gone cold twice. Come home whichever way you like, just don't take all night.
chapters.title: Long Way Home

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.summary: The boats came in hours ago and we're still down on the sand, counting crabs in the rock pools. I make it eleven. You make it nine, and you say I counted the same crab twice. That one was a different crab, it was waving. The sky's going pink and my feet are cold, but I want a recount.
chapters.title: Turn of the Tide

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.summary: The striped lighthouse over the water has been dark all year. I'm fairly sure it's haunted. You packed a picnic anyway, with the good jam. If a ghost turns up, I'm telling it the sandwiches were your idea. Save me the one with the most jam.
chapters.title: Sleeping Lighthouse

chapters.summary: The little cottage up top has been empty all winter, and today we're moving in. Right after breakfast, you said. Finish your cup and I'll wash up, then we're going.

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.summary: I'm writing this from the deck, where the breeze is lovely and nobody's shouting. Well, you're shouting. You say the grass down below is warmer, and you've said it about nine times since lunch. I can see your hat from up here and it looks very small. Come up and see for yourself, or I'll come down, but only for a bit.
chapters.title: High and Low

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.summary: It's a short walk home across the meadow, or it should be. You've stopped to say hello to every bee, and some of them twice. We set off after lunch and I can still see the tree we sat under. I've started counting bees too, so I can't really tell you off. See you at the next hedge.
chapters.title: Rolling Home

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.summary: It's our first evening in the new house and we still haven't agreed who gets the top shelf. You've already hung a painting up there. It's upside down. I haven't said anything yet, because you looked so pleased with it. The workshop smells of sawdust, and one of the hanging plants already has a name. You called it Gerald.
chapters.title: A House for Two

chapters.checkpoint_text: Your friend can carry on from here.
chapters.completion_text: Both lights are able to reach the garden.
chapters.summary: Somebody was meant to water the ferns this week, and I'm sure it was you. You're just as sure it was me. It's warm under the glass, and the hanging baskets drip on whoever stands underneath, which today was me. My hat is soaked. Let's water them together and never talk about it again.
